name: Cyber Rage: Retribution 🕹️ Play on CrazyGames
author: CrazyGames
description: Cyber Rage: Retribution is a cool 3D side-scrolling fighter game in which you and your friend can battle your way through the streets and try to take out the bad guys using a combo of punches, kicks, and special moves.    You can also pick up some amazing weapons on your way to dish out more damage.
